# Beta Playtest Template

## Basic flow

- [ ] Stage goal is understandable within the intro.
- [ ] Movement, jump, dash and attack react immediately.
- [ ] New ability has a safe learn space before a difficult use.
- [ ] Required orbs teach the intended route and are not unfairly hidden.
- [ ] Repair clearly changes a route, safety or available action.
- [ ] Repair before / during / after can be understood at a glance.
- [ ] Enemies create a decision without trapping the player.
- [ ] Checkpoints follow meaningful progress moments.
- [ ] Death cause is understandable and recovery is short.
- [ ] Gate, result and next destination are clear.

## Technical checks

- [ ] Console has no relevant errors.
- [ ] All stage assets load.
- [ ] Save/reload preserves safe Chapter 1 progress.
- [ ] Esc menu and F2 developer tools work.
- [ ] Relevant feature flags work when OFF.
